note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 11 corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation or operations.

migration_stages.title: Mapping and Validation Stage
migration_stages.source_authority: The source system remains authoritative throughout this stage.
migration_stages.provenance: Every mapped record retains its source provenance and lineage.
migration_stages.uncertainty: Uncertain mappings are preserved as uncertain and never silently resolved.
migration_stages.identity_candidate: Identity candidates are treated as candidates and not asserted as resolved identities.
migration_stages.quarantine: Records failing validation are quarantined rather than admitted.
migration_stages.rehearsal_boundary: This stage is rehearsal-only and authorizes no migration.
migration_stages.acceptance_boundary: This stage authorizes no business acceptance.
migration_stages.rollback: This stage is fully reversible; no source state is mutated.
migration_stages.source_retirement: This stage authorizes no source retirement.
migration_stages.mapping_vs_identity: Mapping complete is not identity resolved.

migration_stages.title: Rehearsal Stage
migration_stages.source_authority: The source system remains authoritative during rehearsal.
migration_stages.provenance: Rehearsal preserves provenance for every record processed.
migration_stages.uncertainty: Rehearsal preserves and reports uncertainty rather than resolving it.
migration_stages.identity_candidate: Identity candidates remain candidates during rehearsal.
migration_stages.quarantine: Quarantine behaviour is exercised without admitting quarantined records.
migration_stages.rollback: Rehearsal is fully reversible and mutates no source or target of record.

migration_stages.title: Cutover Authorization Stage
migration_stages.source_authority: Source authority persists until an explicit, evidenced cutover authorization.
migration_stages.provenance: Cutover authorization depends on complete provenance evidence.
migration_stages.identity_candidate: Unresolved identity candidates block cutover authorization.
migration_stages.rehearsal_boundary: A successful rehearsal is a precondition but is not itself authorization.
migration_stages.cutover_boundary: Cutover is not acceptance and is not source retirement.
migration_stages.acceptance_boundary: Business acceptance is a distinct, later obligation.
migration_stages.rollback: A defined rollback must exist before cutover authorization.
migration_stages.source_retirement: Source retirement is a distinct, later authorization.

reconciliations.reconciliation: Reconciliation compares migrated records against source and governed state, reporting differences with retained evidence and no silent correction.
